description: This file contains Python classes and methods for processing JSON test results and generating a dashboard for layout tests, specifically related to the 'generate_results_dashboard.py' script in the WebKit project.

classes.name: ProcessJsonData
classes.description: Handles processing and archiving of JSON test result data, including recursive result extraction and result archiving.

classes.name: DashBoardGenerator
classes.description: Generates a test results dashboard by initializing, processing archived results, and creating a JSON report.

methods.description: Recursively traverses JSON object to find specific test result data.

methods.name: ProcessJsonData._process_previous_json_results
methods.description: Processes previous test results for comparison.

methods.name: ProcessJsonData._add_archived_result
methods.description: Adds archived test results to JSON object.
